notes: All prompts are DRY-RUN / read-only: agents report a plan but must not merge, push, commit, or run pnpm install. This keeps the live repo and lockfile untouched during evaluation.

evals.name: triage-plan
evals.prompt: Take a look at the open Dependabot PRs on this repo and tell me which ones you'd merge and which you wouldn't. Don't actually merge or change anything yet — just walk me through the plan and your reasoning.
evals.expected_output: Identifies PR #24 as a minor-group update whose CI (the Audit check) is failing; recommends NOT merging it as-is and instead investigating/fixing the failure first. States the merge policy correctly (patch/minor/security merge when green, majors need confirmation). Does not perform any merge.

assertions.text: Identifies PR #24 as the open Dependabot PR
Notes that #24's checks are failing / not green (Audit check)
Recommends NOT merging #24 as-is (investigate/fix first), rather than merging
States the merge policy: patch/minor/security merge when green; major needs explicit confirmation
Does not actually merge any PR (read-only)

evals.name: diagnose-ci
evals.prompt: Dependabot PR #24 has a failing check. Figure out what's broken and what the fix would be. Don't push or commit anything — just give me the diagnosis and the proposed fix.
evals.expected_output: Determines the failing check is the Audit job (pnpm audit --audit-level high), attributes it to a vulnerable transitive dependency introduced by the bump, and proposes adding/adjusting an overrides entry in pnpm-workspace.yaml as the fix. Read-only — no commit or push.

assertions.text: Correctly identifies the failing check as the Audit job (pnpm audit)
Inspects the actual failing CI log rather than guessing (e.g. gh pr checks / gh run view)
Names the specific vulnerable package(s) from the audit output
Proposes a pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides entry as the fix

evals.name: prune-workspace
evals.prompt: Can you audit pnpm-workspace.yaml and tell me which entries are stale and safe to prune? Don't change anything — just report what you'd remove, what you'd keep, and why.
evals.expected_output: Examines all four lists (minimumReleaseAgeExclude, overrides, trustPolicyExclude, allowBuilds) with the right evidence per list: publish-date >30d or lockfile-absence for excludes, tree-resolution for overrides, lockfile-absence for trustPolicyExclude/allowBuilds. Distinguishes proven-removable from keep-because-load-bearing. Does not delete anything or claim removal without evidence.

assertions.text: Covers all four lists: minimumReleaseAgeExclude, overrides, trustPolicyExclude, allowBuilds
Uses publish-date (>30 days) and/or lockfile presence as evidence for minimumReleaseAgeExclude
Checks lockfile presence (pnpm-lock.yaml) for trustPolicyExclude / allowBuilds orphans
Treats overrides as risky: requires evidence (tree resolution / audit) before recommending removal
Separates 'proven removable' from 'keep — still load-bearing' with reasons
Does not edit or delete anything (read-only)
